result_text:
`all_files.zip` now takes its entry names from the configured aspect names, so renaming an aspect no longer breaks it. I only compiled the `reports` module (it compiled cleanly); I didn't run any tests or try a renamed config.

The change is in `DataExporter.java`, in the zip-writing block of `saveData`. It no longer reads fixed `aspect_*.txt` literals. It now builds the five entries (main, test, generated, build and deployment, other) from the same aspects and the same `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")` call that writes the loose text files. The zip therefore always looks up the file under the name it was written with.

With the default config the entries and their order are unchanged. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the zip holds `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt` in fourth place. The old failure came from reading a file that no longer existed. That threw and skipped the `git-history.zip` step too, so it is written again when `git-history.txt` exists.
